mission: Build and empirically prove an application-neutral Cognitive Multitool for EntityOS. The same cognitive contract supports hot-swappable system prompts, databases, identities, tasks and tools, and can run through an optional resident ClayCog 0.5B neural kernel, the original dual-Mistral path, or other configured backends.

core_contract.hal: EntityOS calls one Cognitive Multitool contract rather than a model-specific interface
core_contract.concurrent_slots: optional when independent sequence/KV state exists; hard capsule/DB isolation required
core_contract.fallback: 0.5B may be disabled and two Mistrals substituted without changing the Cognitive Multitool result contract

portable_release_shape: replaceable dual-Mistral or other inference backend

hard_split.runtime: cognitive scheduling, capsule binding, backend routing, deterministic gates and canonical persistence
hard_split.weights: universal ClayCog/GRF/Hyperposition cognition only; never fixed identity/job/persona/application
hard_split.regression: never hard-code replaceable entity/personality/provider/model semantics into the cognitive kernel contract

truth_law: UNKNOWN != ZERO != ERROR != MEASURED; neural output is never canonical state/effect authority

inference_law.local_0_5b: resident Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct ClayCog kernel when enabled
inference_law.mistral_dual: two-Mistral replacement path implementing the same cognitive contract
inference_law.auto: cheap/local cognition with escalation to stronger configured backend
inference_law.identity: switching backend, system prompt or DB binding must not reset or cross-contaminate canonical state

go: Every exact go must make measurable progress in BOTH lanes: TRAINING (generate/expand/validate/evaluate ClayCog training data or fine-tune readiness/checkpoint behavior) and MODULE (implement/test Cognitive Multitool runtime, hot-swap capsule/DB, backend router, scheduler/slots, isolation, deterministic gates or integration). Analysis-only go is insufficient unless a newly proven blocker is persisted with evidence.
go_progression: refresh -> corpus/trajectory expansion -> strict validation -> module implementation -> prompt/DB hot-swap + isolation -> 0.5B-off dual-Mistral substitution -> Together admission/price/job -> base-vs-tuned eval -> hidden-state probes -> Q4_K_M -> <1GiB RSS -> EntityOS integration -> persist
swarm_product_rule: swarm is research/build orchestration only; runtime may multiplex many cognitive tasks through one shared model or use multiple configured backends
legacy_scope: Previous Mini Entity/ClayVerse/EntityOS/Frank/UCM/GWT/ClayCode work remains donor evidence and compatibility surface; the current build target is the Cognitive Multitool and its optional 0.5B accelerator.
together_api: OWNER_AUTHORIZED_BOUNDED_FOR_CLAYCOG_0_5B_TRAINING_ONLY; campaign maximum EUR 20 equivalent; no billed create before exact admission and price preflight
